name: dealer-new-customer-onboarding
description: Design a comprehensive 90-day post-sale customer onboarding program for a car dealership. Multi-channel (email + SMS + in-person + optional ringless voicemail) covering delivery through first service intro. Built around the critical sales-to-service handoff that determines long-term service retention. Includes OEM-specific connected services activation flows (OnStar, FordPass, Uconnect, etc.). 4 phases, 15-20 touchpoints, ready-to-use templates per touchpoint.
